subject: Promo credit packaging & shelf-life — operational/contract ask
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@seedlab.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver@seedlab.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credit packaging — questions about expiry and escrow

Hi Marissa,

Quick note after our internal billing sync — thanks again for the onboarding credits offer. Two operational questions came up on our end that we need clarified before we sign the SOW: 

1) Can the promotional credits be consolidated into a single credit balance that SeedLab can draw from across multiple product lines (text gen + embeddings)? Or do credits need to stay siloed by program?

2) What is the shelf-life / expiry policy for these promotional credits? Our finance team prefers at least 12 months; internal counsel is pushing for no-expiry language if the credits are escrowed.

I attached a short spreadsheet summarizing our expected consumption profile. Also attaching the draft SOW — we flagged the credits clause on page 4.

If consolidation + extended shelf-life are possible, we may be able to accept a smaller committed discount in exchange (i.e., convert some discount into longer credit duration). Want to surface this before legal redlines.

Can you confirm who on your side owns escrow/ops conversations (legal or sales ops)?

Thanks — Samira

Attachment: SeedLab_Credit_Summary.xlsx
Attachment: Draft_SOW_credits_clause.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@seedlab.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 12:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credit packaging — questions about expiry and escrow

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet.

Short answers up front:
- Consolidation: Yes, we can consolidate the credits into one pool that covers multiple product surfaces (text + embeddings + reranking). That is our default for accelerator cohorts unless a partner-specific carveout is requested.
- Shelf-life: Standard promo credits we issue typically have a 12-month expiration from grant date. Escrow/no-expiry requests are handled on a case-by-case basis and usually require a brief legal addendum and finance approval.

Notes / next steps: 
- Ben and Laura are cc'd for pricing/ops and legal routing. Ben — can you run a quick margin check if we extend to 18 months or no expiry (what discount delta would you need)?
- Laura — if SeedLab wants escrow language, can your team review the clause in the attached SOW and propose a minimal addendum that preserves our revenue recognition controls?

Samira — if it helps, we can do: 12 months standard OR 18 months with a 10% reduction in the promo pool (i.e., we convert 10% of the promotional value into a nominal platform discount for the committed period). That keeps it simple for accounting. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to align.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — quick add from pricing ops: 

If SeedLab wants to move to 18 months or remove expiry with escrow, the levers we typically use are: 
- Reduce promotional pool by 8–12% (range depends on expected token mix).
- Convert a portion of the promo value to a time-bound platform discount (e.g., 6 months at 15% off compute).
- Require a minimal non-monetary commitment: billing contact + usage forecast cadence + a short pilot acceptance milestone for accounting.

For an initial proposal: 18 months expiry + 10% promo pool reduction OR no expiry with a 12% reduction and an escrow addendum. The escrow addendum typically requires legal review but is operationally straightforward (we place a record in our finance system and trigger release rules).

Samira — attached is a one-pager I put together with estimated cost delta based on your spreadsheet. Happy to run numbers with specific token split if you want tighter figures.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachment: Promo_value_delta_1pager.pdf

Samira — looping back after internal alignment. Laura drafted a short addendum we can attach to the SOW that covers escrow mechanics and limits our revrec exposure. Ben ran numbers and confirmed the 12% delta for no-expiry + escrow. 

Proposal options (pick one):
A) Standard: consolidated credit pool, 12-month expiry, no change to promo value.
B) Extended: consolidated pool, 18-month expiry, promo pool reduced by 10% (Ben's suggested midpoint).
C) Escrow/no-expiry: consolidated pool, no expiry, promo pool reduced by 12% + signed escrow addendum (attached).

If you prefer B or C, we can prepare a redlined SOW and a DocuSign packet today. If you want us to model with a 60/40 text/embeddings split for expected consumption, Ben can return exact dollar deltas.

Thanks — available for a 20-minute call this afternoon if you'd like to finalize.

Best,
Marissa
